proposals.evidence: Perder p165 explicitly defines pā̃c-o cōr as an approximate four-five expression, literally five and four. Ordered lexical components are pā̃c five then cōr four; -o is the coordinating clitic. Preserve the source order and its conventional approximation meaning rather than treating the phrase as arithmetic nine or correcting it to four + five. Both numeral bases already have approved histories. Saved under the user’s standing numeral approval.
